articles.title: USN-8996-1: APT vulnerability
articles.summary: Max Justicz discovered that APT incorrectly handled hard links when encountering redirects and retrying package downloads. A remote on-path attacker could possibly use this issue to trick APT into installing an unverified package and achieve remote code execution with root privileges.

articles.title: CISA flags WordPress RCE flaw as actively exploited in attacks
articles.summary: The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned federal agencies that attackers have started exploiting a recently patched high-severity WordPress vulnerability in the wild. [...]

articles.title: CVE-2026-90626 — CVSS 7.3
articles.summary:
An uncontrolled memory access in the PDF import code of Apache OpenOffice versions through 4.1.16 allows a crafted PDF to cause an out-of-bounds memory write, causing program crash or memory corruption.
Users are recommended to upgrade to version 4.1.17, which fixes this issue.

articles.title: CVE-2026-90624 — CVSS 7.3
articles.summary:
An unchecked memory access in the PDF import code of Apache OpenOffice versions through 4.1.16 on allows a crafted PDF to execute an out-of-bounds memory write. This could crash the program or cause memory corruption.
Users are recommended to upgrade to version 4.1.17, which fixes this issue.

articles.title: CVE-2026-59268 — CVSS 7.3
articles.summary:
An out-of-bounds Write vulnerability in Apache OpenOffice versions through 4.1.16 could allow an attacker to craft a Microsoft Word document that would crash the program, or otherwise corrupt other memory areas.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 4.1.17, which fixes this issue.

articles.title: CVE-2026-59264 — CVSS 7.8
articles.summary:
The Windows installers of Apache OpenOffice 4.1.16 and earlier allow an already manipulated system to run external code with elevated access.
Users are recommended to upgrade to version 4.1.17, which fixes this issue.

articles.title: CVE-2026-94460
articles.summary:
IRISPowerscan contain an insecure default
configuration where the built-in installation account is assigned elevated
privileges with a predictable password, which could allow an unauthenticated
attacker to gain unauthorised access to privileged application functionality.

articles.title: CVE-2026-94459
articles.summary:
IRISPowerscan contain
default user accounts with predictable credentials. An unauthenticated attacker
with access to an affected installation could use these credentials to
authenticate to the application and access functionality available to the
affected accounts, potentially resulting in unauthorised access or modification
of application data and configuration.

Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in TÜBİTAK BİLGEM Software Technologies Research Institute İmzager allows Path Traversal.

This issue affects İmzager: from 2.10.5 before 2.10.7.

articles.title: CVE-2026-114426
articles.summary: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.1.1 processes and writes v1 file-interface upload data before authenticating the caller and without an absolute request-size limit. An unauthenticated remote attacker can occupy workers and consume temporary storage with concurrent or slow requests, causing service unavailability.

articles.title: CVE-2026-114425
articles.summary: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.1.1 trusts a file path supplied in externally provided Large File Transfer attachment metadata. An unauthenticated remote sender can cause the mail-processing worker to disclose, move, or delete an accessible regular file when LFT is enabled and the message reaches an affected secure-mail processing path. The validated workers ran as root.

articles.title: CVE-2026-114424
articles.summary: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.1.1 can evaluate attacker-influenced replacement text as Perl code in sender or recipient replacement rules. An unauthenticated remote sender can execute operating-system commands in the mail-processing worker context when an active rule uses message-derived replacement data and its search condition matches. The validated worker context was root.

articles.title: CVE-2026-114421
articles.summary: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.1.1 permits password recovery for a created but unregistered GINA account whose initial password is empty without adequately verifying ownership. A remote unauthenticated attacker who identifies such an account can set a new password, authenticate as that account, and prevent the intended recipient from using it until recovery.

articles.title: CVE-2026-114420
articles.summary: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.1.1 does not neutralize LDAP metacharacters in an unauthenticated account-selection input in its GINA web interface. A remote unauthenticated attacker can enumerate email addresses.
